amp_simulator.keywords: amp simulator amplifier guitar bass preamp power amp tube valve distortion overdrive crunch lead clean tone stack fender marshall presence sag oversampling di reamp
slider_desc: Amp voicing: Clean (2 stages, Fender stack), Crunch (3 stages, Marshall stack), Lead (4 stages, tight lows) or Bass (2 stages, deep stack).
Preamp drive into the first tube stage; the range depends on the model (up to +46 dB on Lead).
Tone stack bass control (audio taper). Bass, Mid and Treble interact like a real passive tone stack.
Tone stack mid control; low values give the classic mid scoop.
Tone stack treble control.
Power amp presence: a high shelf at 3 kHz from -8 to +8 dB.
Power amp drive and volume: higher values push the push-pull stage into saturation.
Bright switch: a treble boost before the preamp that is strongest at low Gain, like a bright cap.
Power supply sag: the power amp's drive drops as the level rises, for a softer, compressed feel.
2x or 4x oversampling of the nonlinear stages (polyphase IIR half-band filters, no latency).
Final output level.
uses: Turning DI guitar into a clean, crunch or lead amp tone (add Cabinet Simulator after it)
Bass amp grit and growl on DI bass
Re-amping recorded DI tracks
Driving synths, drums or vocals through a tube amp character
amp_simulator.properties: Input → tight high-pass → Bright shelf → 2x/4x oversampling: 2–4 asymmetric inverting triode stages, each with coupling-cap high-pass and Miller low-pass → passive Fender/Marshall tone stack (Yeh's third-order model) → power amp resonance and Presence → push-pull soft clipper with supply sag → downsampling → DC blocker → Output. No cabinet; zero latency.

pitch_correction.properties: Signal chain: Input → mono 50 Hz high-pass + 1.2 kHz 4th-order low-pass, decimated to ~11 kHz → YIN pitch tracker (70 Hz to 1 kHz, new estimate every ~6 ms, Sensitivity = threshold) → nearest Key/Scale note with hysteresis → Retune glide + Humanize (vibrato kept) → TD-PSOLA shifter (peak-aligned pitch marks, two-period Hann grains, formants preserved; stereo kept) → Dry/Wet Mix → Output. Monophonic sources only; unvoiced sounds pass with the transpose only; latency about 39 ms, reported to the host (PDC).

slider_desc: Maximum reduction per frequency.
How narrow the peaks it targets are: the spectral envelope is averaged over 2 octaves at 0% down to 1/8 octave at 100%.

How fast the reduction grabs, per FFT frame.
How fast the reduction lets go.
Lowest frequency processed (fades out over half an octave below).

resonance_suppressor.properties: STFT with 2048-point FFT, 75% overlap and sqrt-Hann windows; both channels in one complex FFT, linked detection on their mean power. Each bin's level is compared with a log-frequency moving average of the spectrum; the excess over the Selectivity threshold sets the reduction (Soft or Hard), smoothed per frame (Attack/Release) and across neighbouring bins, limited to Low–High Freq. Perfect reconstruction when nothing is reduced. Latency: 2047 samples (reported to the host).

resonator.properties: Signal chain: Input → 20 Hz High-Pass → up to 4 Karplus-Strong string loops per channel (one per chord note) → DC Blocker → Soft Ceiling → Mix → Output. Each loop is a delay line, a first-order allpass for the fractional part of the period and a linear-phase 3-tap low-pass, so every harmonic is exactly in tune. The loop gain sets the decay of the fundamental and stays below 1, the input to each loop is scaled for unity noise power, and the wet sum has a soft ceiling at 0 dBFS, so it can ring but never run away. No latency.

volume_shaper.properties: Signal chain: Input → Gain × (1 − Depth × (1 − Shape)) → One-pole Smoothing → Dry/Wet Mix → Output. The shapes are breakpoint curves over one cycle; the cycle follows the host tempo and, while the transport plays, is read from the song position so it stays locked to the grid; stopped, it free-runs at the host tempo. Half-time Pump spans two Rate notes. Stereo-linked, zero latency.
